verses.ar: لِدَاوُدَ عِنْدَمَا غَيَّرَ عَقْلَهُ قُدَّامَ أَبِيمَالِكَ فَطَرَدَهُ فَٱنْطَلَقَ أُبَارِكُ ٱلرَّبَّ فِي كُلِّ حِينٍ. دَائِمًا تَسْبِيحُهُ فِي فَمِي.
verses.kjv: [A Psalm] of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise [shall] continually [be] in my mouth.
verses.web: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

verses.ar: بِٱلرَّبِّ تَفْتَخِرُ نَفْسِي. يَسْمَعُ ٱلْوُدَعَاءُ فَيَفْرَحُونَ.
verses.kjv: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear [thereof], and be glad.
verses.web: My soul shall boast in Yahweh. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

verses.ar: عَظِّمُوا ٱلرَّبَّ مَعِي، وَلْنُعَلِّ ٱسْمَهُ مَعًا.
verses.kjv: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
verses.web: Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

verses.ar: طَلَبْتُ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ فَٱسْتَجَابَ لِي، وَمِنْ كُلِّ مَخَاوِفِي أَنْقَذَنِي.
verses.kjv: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
verses.web: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

verses.ar: نَظَرُوا إِلَيْهِ وَٱسْتَنَارُوا، وَوُجُوهُهُمْ لَمْ تَخْجَلْ.
verses.kjv: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
verses.web: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

verses.ar: هَذَا ٱلْمِسْكِينُ صَرَخَ، وَٱلرَّبُّ ٱسْتَمَعَهُ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ ضِيقَاتِهِ خَلَّصَهُ.
verses.kjv: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard [him], and saved him out of all his troubles.
verses.web: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.ar: مَلَاكُ ٱلرَّبِّ حَالٌّ حَوْلَ خَائِفِيهِ، وَيُنَجِّيهِمْ.
verses.kjv: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
verses.web: Yahweh’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

verses.ar: ذُوقُوا وَٱنْظُرُوا مَا أَطْيَبَ ٱلرَّبَّ! طُوبَى لِلرَّجُلِ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلِ عَلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: O taste and see that the LORD [is] good: blessed [is] the man [that] trusteth in him.
verses.web: Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

verses.ar: ٱتَّقُوا ٱلرَّبَّ يَا قِدِّيسِيهِ، لِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ عَوَزٌ لِمُتَّقِيهِ.
verses.kjv: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for [there is] no want to them that fear him.
verses.web: Oh fear Yahweh, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

verses.ar: ٱلْأَشْبَالُ ٱحْتَاجَتْ وَجَاعَتْ، وَأَمَّا طَالِبُو ٱلرَّبِّ فَلَا يُعْوِزُهُمْ شَيْءٌ مِنَ ٱلْخَيْرِ.
verses.kjv: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good [thing].
verses.web: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.

verses.ar: هَلُمَّ أَيُّهَا ٱلْبَنُونَ ٱسْتَمِعُوا إِلَيَّ فَأُعَلِّمَكُمْ مَخَافَةَ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
verses.web: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of Yahweh.

verses.ar: مَنْ هُوَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ ٱلَّذِي يَهْوَى ٱلْحَيَاةَ، وَيُحِبُّ كَثْرَةَ ٱلْأَيَّامِ لِيَرَى خَيْرًا؟
verses.kjv: What man [is he that] desireth life, [and] loveth [many] days, that he may see good?
verses.web: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

verses.ar: صُنْ لِسَانَكَ عَنِ ٱلشَّرِّ، وَشَفَتَيْكَ عَنِ ٱلتَّكَلُّمِ بِٱلْغِشِّ.
verses.kjv: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
verses.web: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

verses.ar: حِدْ عَنِ ٱلشَّرِّ، وَٱصْنَعِ ٱلْخَيْرَ. ٱطْلُبِ ٱلسَّلَامَةَ، وَٱسْعَ وَرَاءَهَا.
verses.kjv: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
verses.web: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.ar: عَيْنَا ٱلرَّبِّ نَحْوَ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ، وَأُذُنَاهُ إِلَى صُرَاخِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: The eyes of the LORD [are] upon the righteous, and his ears [are open] unto their cry.
verses.web: Yahweh’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

verses.ar: وَجْهُ ٱلرَّبِّ ضِدُّ عَامِلِي ٱلشَّرِّ لِيَقْطَعَ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ذِكْرَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: The face of the LORD [is] against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
verses.web: Yahweh’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

verses.ar: أُولَئِكَ صَرَخُوا، وَٱلرَّبُّ سَمِعَ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ شَدَائِدِهِمْ أَنْقَذَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: [The righteous] cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
verses.web: The righteous cry, and Yahweh hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

verses.ar: قَرِيبٌ هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ مِنَ ٱلْمُنْكَسِرِي ٱلْقُلُوبِ، وَيُخَلِّصُ ٱلْمُنْسَحِقِي ٱلرُّوحِ.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
verses.web: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

verses.ar: كَثِيرَةٌ هِيَ بَلَايَا ٱلصِّدِّيقِ، وَمِنْ جَمِيعِهَا يُنَجِّيهِ ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: Many [are] the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
verses.web: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.

verses.ar: يَحْفَظُ جَمِيعَ عِظَامِهِ. وَاحِدٌ مِنْهَا لَا يَنْكَسِرُ.
verses.kjv: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
verses.web: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

verses.ar: ٱلشَّرُّ يُمِيتُ ٱلشِّرِّيرَ، وَمُبْغِضُو ٱلصِّدِّيقِ يُعَاقَبُونَ.
verses.kjv: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
verses.web: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ فَادِي نُفُوسِ عَبِيدِهِ، وَكُلُّ مَنِ ٱتَّكَلَ عَلَيْهِ لَا يُعَاقَبُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
verses.web: Yahweh redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.
